items.title: Close the broker client's superseded socket without rejecting the live request
items.description: We have an intermittent failure in the daemon broker client. After a shutdown, when a superseded connection closes while a new request is already in flight on a replacement connection, that in-flight request is rejected with a connection-closed error instead of completing. The close handler must only fail the requests that were issued on the closing socket, and the reconnect must only run when the closing socket is still the current one. A new socket must not share buffered data with the socket it replaced.
acceptance_criteria: a ping issued on a replacement connection resolves after the previous socket closes
the close of a superseded socket leaves the current connection and its buffer intact
